programs.title: CNBC On Assignment
programs.desc: CNBC goes on assignment at the biggest events around the world, bringing you interviews and insight from the most influential leaders in business, politics, activism and the arts.

programs.title: Converge
programs.desc: CNBC delivers 24-hour live business intelligence, financial market tracking, and macroeconomic analysis focusing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, mainland Chinese market spillover, and pan-Asian trade regulatory updates.

programs.title: CNBC Explains
programs.desc: ‘CNBC Explains' is a dynamic explainer series that dives deep into the forces shaping our world. Each episode unpacks complex business and economic topics, breaking them down into clear, compelling narratives. With expert insights, data-driven visuals and a global perspective, this series helps viewers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters.

programs.title: Closing Bell: Overtime Rpt
programs.desc: When the bell rings, the action does not end. “Closing Bell: Overtime” takes you through all of the after-hours moves including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading. Big investors, smart strategists and top money managers debate actionable ideas and the big market themes of the day, and get viewers ready for tomorrow's trading day.

programs.title: Fast Money Rpt
programs.desc: “Fast Money” is America's post-market show. Hosted by Melissa Lee and a roundtable of top traders, “Fast Money” breaks through the noise of the day, to bring you the actionable news that matters most to investors.

programs.title: Channel Japan
programs.desc: 'Channel Japan' offers a fresh look at the latest in the economy, business, technology, culture and sightseeing of Japan.
